# Data

## Number of LGAs by State

```{r}
combined_dataset_no_controls <- readxl::read_xlsx("C:/Users/David/Desktop/MicroEcon - Rent/RentAnalysis/Data/Cleaned Data/combined_dataset_no_controls.xlsx", sheet = "LGA")

LGAs_by_state <- combined_dataset_no_controls |>
  dplyr::group_by(State) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Count = dplyr::n_distinct(LGA))

LGAs_by_state

```

## Observation and valid LGA summaries

### Valid LGA: Median Rent

```{r}
median_rent_summary <- build_LGA_and_observation_summary(outcome = "Median_Rent",
                                     control_folder = "Data/Final Data/With Controls/LGA",
                                     non_control_folder = "Data/Final Data/No Controls/LGA")
median_rent_LGA <- build_valid_LGA_table(median_rent_summary$LGA_counts)
cat(median_rent_LGA)
```

### Valid LGA: New Bonds

```{r}

new_bonds_summary <- build_LGA_and_observation_summary(outcome = "New_Bonds",
                                     control_folder = "Data/Final Data/With Controls/LGA",
                                     non_control_folder = "Data/Final Data/No Controls/LGA")

new_bonds_LGA <- build_valid_LGA_table(new_bonds_summary$LGA_counts)
cat(new_bonds_LGA)
```

### Observation: Median Rent

```{r}
median_rent_obs <- build_observation_table(median_rent_summary$Observations)
cat(median_rent_obs)
```


### Observation: New Bonds
```{r}
new_bonds_obs <- build_observation_table(new_bonds_summary$Observations)
```
